# SentientUI

> SentientUI makes websites adapt to each visitor. The SDK observes behaviour, classifies
> visitors into personas (buyer, researcher, deal_seeker, browser, unknown), and a server-side
> persona-keyed optimizer picks — per visitor type — which styling, content, and section order
> to show, learning from real conversions. Decisions are locked per session: Visit 1 learns,
> Visit 2 converts. React SDK, vanilla JS SDK, and a script-tag snippet are open source; the
> learning API is hosted (api.sentient-ui.com).

## Install (agent quickstart)

- React app: `npx @sentientui/cli init` — detects the framework (Next App/Pages, Vite, Remix, CRA),
  installs @sentientui/react, writes .env.local, scaffolds an example. It does NOT edit your
  layout: it prints the wrap snippet — you must wrap the app with <AdaptiveRoot> (or
  <AdaptiveProvider>) yourself, or nothing adapts and nothing is tracked. Works with NO API key
  (keyless local mode: deterministic simulated decisions).
  Verify by opening the app with `?sentient_persona=buyer` vs `?sentient_persona=deal_seeker`.
- Real learning: create a project at https://sentient-ui.com, put the pk_ key in
  NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTIENT_API_KEY, add the domain to allowed origins.
- Non-React site: use @sentientui/snippet (one script tag, Style rung only) or
  @sentientui/core (full JS SDK).

## The four rungs (exact APIs, @sentientui/react)

- Rung 0 Observe: install = visitor intelligence in the dashboard. No authoring.
- Rung 1 Style (CSS only):
  - Persona attributes on <html>: data-sentient-persona="buyer|researcher|deal_seeker|browser|unknown",
    data-sentient-confidence="low|medium|high". Requires suppressHydrationWarning on <html> and
    AdaptiveRoot at the top of the tree. Write plain CSS against these.
  - useAdaptiveTokens(id: string, dims: Record<string, readonly string[]>, opts?: { goal?: string | GoalConfig })
    → { tokens: Record<string, string>; props: Record<string, string> } — spread props
    (data-<dim> attributes) on the element; 1–4 dims, 2–6 values each, first value = baseline.
- Rung 2 Swap:
  - useAdaptive<T>(id: string, config: { variants: Record<string, T>; goal: string | GoalConfig })
    → { variant, value, bind, fireGoal } — attach bind to a rendered element; goal is required.
  - <Adaptive id variants goal /> (wrapper form), <AdaptiveText id default /> (managed text).
- Rung 3 Reorder:
  - <AdaptiveGroup id arrangements={Record<string, string[]>} baseline? goal?> keyed children
    </AdaptiveGroup> — declared orders of keyed children only; first arrangement = baseline.
  - AdaptiveRoot sections={string[]} + useLayoutOrder() for page-level section order.

## Docs

- React SDK: packages/react/README.md (in-repo) or https://sentient-ui.com/docs
- Core SDK: packages/core/README.md
- MCP server for agents: @sentientui/mcp (tool get_integration_guide returns this guide expanded)
- This package: the four rungs above are importable from '@sentientui/react' (AdaptiveRoot from '@sentientui/react/next'; testing helpers from '@sentientui/react/testing').
